title: Football Kick: Compressing a Penalty Shootout into an Angle-by-Power Judgement Table
subtitle: The rule skeleton of a 5-round penalty duel: aim angle and shot power are sliced into three judgement bands — guaranteed miss, risk zone and sweet spot — with probability deciding goal, save or miss. Playable demo included.

breakdown.title: Rule Skeleton
bullets: 5 penalty rounds (maxRounds=5); each shot advances the round, then the match settles
Three verdicts: goal / save / miss; only goals score; the AI keeper is a placeholder (aiScore stays 0)
Winner decided by comparing both scores; draws allowed — one goal locks the win

breakdown.title: Behavior Loop
bullets: Aim (aim.update writes angle/power, angle clamped to ±80°) → shoot (shot.take)
executeShot judges via the three-band table → shot.result returns → goal scores +1 with SFX
resetScene resets for the next round; round>5 emits game.over and moves to result

breakdown.title: Implementation Notes
bullets: Judgement model lives in the private module football/football-model; sweet-spot save chance = 0.25+|angle|/200
State machine and scoring driven by the v2-kernel logic graph: boot→menu→gameplay→result
Current build is a rules-layer skeleton: aim controls and the 3D scene are not on screen yet, but the judgement chain is fully closed

demo.note: Hit "开始游戏" to enter the shootout, then click "射门" for 5 rounds of judgement — each kick's angle and power are ruled by the model-layer probability table. One goal wins.
